generic.Defined scope/population: All statement filings and acknowledgment receipts filed this cycle across every jurisdiction
generic.In-scope period: The current Annual/Quarterly Statement filing cycle just submitted
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing type, statement period, and domiciliary/foreign state tagged on every archived item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived item count matches the number of jurisdictions filed this cycle
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived PDF and receipt each carry the filing date and version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missing acknowledgment receipt logged with a follow-up owner and target date
generic.Test population: Every jurisdiction filed this cycle, including all foreign/licensed states
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires 100% of filed jurisdictions archived with a receipt on file
generic.Exception handling path: Missing receipts escalate to the Regulatory Reporting Analyst for state follow-up
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filed statement and receipt archived, tagged, and indexed for every jurisdiction
generic.Evidence location: financial reporting repository archive folder for the current filing cycle

steps.title: Pull the filed statement PDF from the financial reporting repository
sop: Open the financial reporting repository and locate the final filed statement PDF for each jurisdiction.
Confirm the file matches the version submitted to NAIC iSite+ or the state portal.
Done when a filed PDF is confirmed for every jurisdiction.
verify: Spot-check three jurisdictions' PDFs against the submission log.
Pass when every checked PDF matches the submitted version.

steps.title: Collect the state acknowledgment/acceptance receipt for each filing
sop: Retrieve the acknowledgment or acceptance receipt from NAIC iSite+ or the state portal for each jurisdiction.
Save each receipt alongside its matching filed statement.
Done when a receipt is collected for every filed jurisdiction.
verify: Count receipts collected against the jurisdiction filing list.
Pass when the receipt count equals the jurisdiction count.

steps.title: Tag each archived filing with statement type, period and state in SharePoint
sop: Open the archive folder in Microsoft 365/SharePoint.
Apply metadata tags for statement type, filing period, and domiciliary/foreign state to each file.
Done when every archived file carries all three tags.
verify: Filter the archive view by tag to confirm no untagged items remain.
Pass when the filtered view returns zero untagged files.

steps.title: Confirm the jurat page signature is present in the archived package
sop: Open each archived statement PDF and navigate to the jurat page.
Confirm the officer signature and date appear on the page.
Done when every archived package shows a signed jurat page.
verify: Re-open a sample of archived jurat pages.
Pass when every sampled jurat page carries a visible signature.

steps.title: Apply the statutory retention period to the archived filing set in SharePoint
sop: Select the archived filing set for the cycle in SharePoint.
Apply the statutory record retention label per the retention policy.
Done when the retention label is applied to the full filing set.
verify: Check the retention label field on the archived set.
Pass when the label matches the statutory retention period.

steps.title: Record the archive location reference in the statutory filing index
sop: Open the statutory filing index in the financial reporting repository.
Enter the SharePoint folder path/link for the archived cycle.
Done when the index shows the archive location for every jurisdiction.
verify: Click the recorded link for two jurisdictions to confirm it resolves.
Pass when both links open the correct archived folder.

steps.title: Reconcile archived item count to the number of jurisdictions filed
sop: Compare the archive folder file count to the jurisdiction filing list.
Investigate any mismatch before closing the cycle.
Done when the counts agree with no unexplained gap.
verify: Recount archived items independently.
Pass when the recount matches the jurisdiction filing list.

steps.title: Close out the archiving task in the statutory filing tracker
sop: Open the regulatory filing/issue tracker entry for the archiving task.
Mark the task complete and attach the filing index reference.
Done when the tracker shows the task closed with the index attached.
verify: Open the tracker entry to confirm status and attachment.
Pass when status is Closed and the index reference is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All red and yellow validation edits produced by the NAIC cross-check report this cycle
generic.In-scope period: The current Annual Statement filing period being validated
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every flagged blank page and line reference resolved or justified
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Edit count on the re-run report matches zero unresolved fatal edits
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each validation edit run saved with its run date and version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every yellow edit left open logged with a written justification
generic.Test population: The full set of validation edits from the final NAIC cross-check run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero unresolved red (fatal) edits on the final run
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved fatal edits escalate to the Senior Accountant for correction before CFO sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clean validation edit report attached to the filing work paper file
generic.Evidence location: financial reporting repository filing work paper folder for the cycle

steps.title: Run the NAIC cross-check/validation edit report in the financial reporting repository
sop: Open the completed Annual Statement blanks in the financial reporting repository.
Execute the NAIC cross-check/validation edit report against the blanks.
Done when the edit report is generated for the current filing.
verify: Confirm the report timestamp matches the current filing cycle.
Pass when the report reflects the latest blank page data.

steps.title: Triage red (fatal) edits by statement page and line
sop: Sort the validation edit report by severity.
List each red edit with its statement page and line reference.
Done when every red edit is logged with its source line.
verify: Cross-check the logged list against the raw edit report.
Pass when every red edit on the report appears in the log.

steps.title: Correct source data in the ERP/GL for each fatal edit
sop: Trace each fatal edit to its underlying GL account or blank page entry in the ERP/GL.
Correct the entry or mapping causing the edit.
Done when a correction is posted or explained for every red edit.
verify: Re-open the corrected GL entries.
Pass when each correction ties to its flagged edit.

steps.title: Document justification for unresolved yellow (informational) edits
sop: Review each remaining yellow edit after fatal edits are cleared.
Write a justification note explaining why the yellow edit is acceptable.
Done when every open yellow edit has a written justification.
verify: Read each justification against its edit description.
Pass when every yellow edit has a justification that matches its condition.

steps.title: Re-run the validation edit report after corrections
sop: Re-run the NAIC cross-check report in the financial reporting repository.
Compare the new results to the prior run.
Done when the re-run shows zero unresolved red edits.
verify: Review the re-run output for any remaining red edits.
Pass when the re-run report shows a clean pass.

steps.title: Attach the final clean validation edit report to the filing work paper file
sop: Save the clean validation edit report PDF to the filing work paper folder.
Label the file with the run date and cycle.
Done when the clean report is attached to the work paper file.
verify: Open the work paper file to confirm the attachment.
Pass when the clean report is present and dated correctly.

generic.Defined scope/population: Schedule P and Underwriting and Investment Exhibit loss reserve schedules for the filing entity
generic.In-scope period: The current statement date's reserve exhibit and opinion package
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Schedule P triangles, reserve exhibit lines, and SAO signature block all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserve exhibit totals tie to the balance sheet loss and LAE reserve lines

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any tie-out break between exhibit and balance sheet logged with resolution
generic.Test population: The completed reserve exhibit and attached actuarial opinion for the statement date
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the exhibit totals to tie exactly to the balance sheet reserve lines
generic.Exception handling path: Ties that fail to reconcile escalate to the Regulatory Reporting Analyst for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exhibit populated, signed SAO attached, and totals tied to the balance sheet
generic.Evidence location: financial reporting repository reserve exhibit work paper folder

steps.title: Populate Schedule P from the actuarial reserve study in the financial reporting repository
sop: Open the actuarial reserve study output.
Enter the loss and LAE triangles into Schedule P by line of business.
Done when every required Schedule P part is populated.
verify: Spot-check two lines of business against the reserve study.
Pass when both lines match the study figures.

steps.title: Populate the Underwriting and Investment Exhibit reserve schedules
sop: Carry the reserve study totals into the Underwriting and Investment Exhibit.
Confirm reserve categories align with Schedule P totals.
Done when the exhibit schedules are fully populated.
verify: Compare exhibit totals to Schedule P totals.
Pass when the two sources agree.

steps.title: Attach the signed Statement of Actuarial Opinion to the exhibit package
sop: Obtain the signed SAO from the appointed actuary.
Attach the SAO PDF to the reserve exhibit package in the financial reporting repository.
Done when the signed SAO is attached to the package.
verify: Open the attached SAO to confirm a signature is present.
Pass when the SAO shows the actuary's signature and date.

steps.title: Confirm the Actuarial Opinion Summary ties to booked reserves
sop: Compare the Actuarial Opinion Summary figures to the booked reserve balances in the ERP/GL.
Note any variance for management review.
Done when the summary figures match the booked reserves.
verify: Recompute the comparison independently.
Pass when the summary and booked reserves match within tolerance.

steps.title: Verify the appointed actuary's qualification statement is current
sop: Retrieve the appointed actuary's qualification statement on file.
Confirm the statement date is within the current filing year.
Done when a current qualification statement is confirmed on file.
verify: Check the qualification statement date.
Pass when the date falls within the required filing year.

steps.title: Confirm reserve exhibit totals tie to the balance sheet reserve lines
sop: Compare exhibit reserve totals to the Balance Sheet loss and LAE reserve lines in the ERP/GL.
Investigate and resolve any difference before finalizing.
Done when exhibit totals tie exactly to the balance sheet.
verify: Re-trace the tie-out calculation.
Pass when no unresolved difference remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: All required NAIC Annual Statement blank pages for the filing entity
generic.In-scope period: The current annual statement date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Balance Sheet, Income Statement, five-year exhibit and interrogatories fully populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every blank page total agrees to the trial balance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed blanks saved with the filing period and draft version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any cross-foot break logged with the correcting entry reference

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires all blank pages cross-foot and tie to the trial balance with zero breaks
generic.Exception handling path: Cross-foot breaks escalate to the Senior Accountant for GL correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All blanks populated, cross-footed, and tied to the trial balance
generic.Evidence location: financial reporting repository Annual Statement work paper folder

steps.title: Populate the Balance Sheet blank pages from the trial balance
sop: Open the extracted statutory trial balance in the ERP/GL.
Enter Assets, Liabilities, and Surplus and Other Funds figures into the Balance Sheet blanks.
Done when every Balance Sheet line is populated.
verify: Foot the Balance Sheet against the trial balance total.
Pass when the footed total ties to the trial balance.

steps.title: Populate the Statement of Income and Capital and Surplus Account blanks
sop: Enter revenue and expense figures into the Statement of Income blank.
Roll forward beginning surplus through the Capital and Surplus Account blank.
Done when both statements are fully populated.
verify: Confirm ending surplus on the Capital and Surplus Account matches the Balance Sheet surplus line.
Pass when the two figures agree.

steps.title: Complete the five-year historical data exhibit
sop: Pull the four prior years' filed statement summary figures from the financial reporting repository.
Enter the current year figures alongside the prior four years in the exhibit.
Done when all five years are populated in the exhibit.
verify: Compare each prior-year column to its originally filed statement.
Pass when every prior-year figure matches its filed statement.

steps.title: Complete the general interrogatories Part 1 and Part 2
sop: Answer each general interrogatory question per current operations and holdings.
Cross-reference answers requiring supporting schedules.
Done when both interrogatory parts are fully answered.
verify: Review answers against the prior period responses for consistency.
Pass when answers are complete with no blank responses.

steps.title: Cross-foot every blank page and confirm page totals agree to the trial balance
sop: Cross-foot each completed blank page for internal mathematical accuracy.
Compare page totals to the corresponding trial balance figures.
Done when every page cross-foots and ties to the trial balance.
verify: Re-foot a sample of pages independently.
Pass when the sample re-foot matches the reported totals.

steps.title: Route the completed blanks for Senior Accountant review
sop: Save the completed blank set to the financial reporting repository.
Notify the Senior Accountant that the blanks are ready for review.
Done when the review request is sent with the completed blank set.
verify: Confirm the Senior Accountant has acknowledged the review request.
Pass when acknowledgment is received before the next filing step.

steps.title: Confirm due dates for every foreign/licensed state

steps.title: Confirm NAIC iSite+ and state electronic filing deadlines align

Done when alignment is confirmed or discrepancies are flagged.

steps.title: Flag any state with an extension request already on file

Flag the affected state row with the extended due date.
Done when every existing extension is flagged in the tracker.
verify: Review flagged rows against extension correspondence on file.

steps.title: Publish the confirmed filing calendar to the statutory reporting team
sop: Export the confirmed calendar from the filing tracker.
Post the calendar to the team SharePoint site.
Done when the calendar is posted and accessible to the team.
verify: Open the posted SharePoint calendar link.
Pass when the calendar opens and reflects the confirmed dates.

steps.title: Record the calendar confirmation version and date in SharePoint
sop: Save the confirmed calendar version with the confirmation date in SharePoint.
Note the confirming reviewer in the file metadata.
Done when the version and confirmation date are recorded.
verify: Open the file metadata to confirm the version date.
Pass when the metadata shows the current confirmation date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Loss/LAE and premium deficiency reserve certifications requested from the appointed actuary

steps.title: Request the loss and LAE reserve adequacy certification from the appointed actuary
sop: Send the certification request to the appointed actuary via email referencing the statement date.
Include the current Schedule P reserve exhibit for reference.
Done when the request is sent with the exhibit attached.
verify: Confirm the actuary acknowledged receipt of the request.
Pass when an acknowledgment is on file.

steps.title: Request the premium deficiency reserve certification where applicable
sop: Determine whether a premium deficiency reserve certification is required this cycle.
Send the request to the appointed actuary if applicable.
Done when the request is sent or the non-applicability is documented.
verify: Review the documented applicability determination.
Pass when the determination is documented either way.

steps.title: Confirm the certification letter references the correct statement date and entity
sop: Open the received certification letter.
Confirm the statement date and legal entity name match the current filing.
Done when both fields are confirmed correct.
verify: Re-check the letter header against the filing entity list.
Pass when the letter matches the correct entity and date.

steps.title: Review the certification for consistency with the Schedule P reserve exhibit
sop: Compare the certified reserve figures to the Schedule P exhibit totals.
Note any variance for follow-up with the actuary.
Done when consistency is confirmed or variances are documented.
verify: Recompute the comparison independently.
Pass when no unresolved variance remains.

steps.title: File the signed reserve certification with the statutory filing work papers
sop: Save the signed certification PDF to the financial reporting repository work paper folder.
Label the file with the statement date and actuary name.
Done when the signed certification is filed in the work papers.
verify: Open the work paper folder to confirm the filed certification.
Pass when the certification is present and correctly labeled.

steps.title: Confirm certification receipt before the filing deadline
sop: Check the certification receipt date against the statutory filing due date.
Escalate to the Controller if receipt is at risk of being late.
Done when the certification is confirmed received ahead of the deadline.
verify: Compare the receipt date to the due date.
Pass when receipt occurred before the statutory due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All Notes to Financial Statements, supplemental exhibits, and the jurat page for the filing
generic.In-scope period: The current Annual Statement filing period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every required note per the NAIC note sequence and jurat officer fields completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Note count matches the required NAIC Annual Statement Instructions note sequence
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Drafted notes saved with a draft version number and date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missing or incomplete note logged with the responsible drafter

steps.title: Draft the Notes to Financial Statements per the NAIC note sequence
sop: Open the NAIC Annual Statement Instructions note sequence checklist.

Done when every required note in the sequence is drafted.
verify: Compare the drafted note list to the required sequence.
Pass when every required note number is present.

steps.title: Draft supplemental exhibits including Reinsurance Interrogatories and Five-Year Historical Data
sop: Draft the Reinsurance Interrogatories responses.
Draft the Five-Year Historical Data exhibit narrative if required.
Done when both supplemental exhibits are drafted.
verify: Review the drafted exhibits for completeness.
Pass when both exhibits are fully drafted.

steps.title: Draft the jurat page with officer names, titles and state of domicile
sop: Enter the certifying officers' names and titles on the jurat page template.
Confirm the state of domicile field matches the filing entity.
Done when the jurat page is drafted with all officer fields complete.
verify: Check officer names against the current officer list.
Pass when names and titles match the current officer roster.

steps.title: Cross-reference each note to its supporting schedule or exhibit
sop: Match each drafted note to its supporting schedule or exhibit in the financial reporting repository.
Add the cross-reference citation to each note.
Done when every note carries a supporting schedule reference.
verify: Spot-check three notes against their cited schedules.
Pass when all three citations resolve to the correct schedule.

steps.title: Route drafted notes and exhibits for internal technical review
sop: Save the drafted notes and exhibits to the review folder in the financial reporting repository.
Notify the technical accounting reviewer that the draft is ready.
Done when the review request is sent with the draft package.
verify: Confirm the reviewer acknowledged the review request.

steps.title: Confirm the acceptance test is met before closing the task
sop: Confirm the task meets its acceptance test: All required notes, exhibits and jurat page drafted and cross-referenced.
Check that no exception remains open against the acceptance test.
Done when the acceptance test is confirmed met with no open exception.
verify: Have the verifier independently re-check the acceptance test outcome.
Pass when the acceptance test is met and no exception remains open.

steps.title: Extract the statutory-basis trial balance from the ERP/GL
sop: Open the ERP/General ledger and run the trial balance report for the statement date.

sop: Check the ERP/GL close status for the period.
